subclasses.name: Fleshwarping
subclasses.description:
Fleshwarping is the magical art of altering flesh and bone. Despite its rather unsavory reputation, fleshwarping has been practiced by a small number of wizards who seek to unlock the secrets of flesh.

In Yvarra, fleshwarping first came about during the Second Arcane Renaissance. Followers of fleshwarping believe that flesh is the fifth element, consisting of blood for vitality, bones for purpose, breath for spirit, and meat for strength.

These wizards are called fleshwarpers. They study anatomy and wield spells that alter flesh. Many engage in extreme body modification and medical practices.

14th The Way of All Flesh

features.name: Fleshwarping Savant
features.description: Beginning when you select this tradition at 2nd level, the gold and time you must spend to copy a spell with the fleshwarping spell tag into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Ironhide
features.description:
Starting at 2nd level, your flesh is protected with fleshwarping magic. While you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Constitution modifier + your Intelligence modifier.

Additionally, when you cast a spell of 1st level or higher with the fleshwarping tag, you gain a bonus to any Constitution saving throw you make to maintain your concentration on the spell, provided you are not wearing any armor or wielding a shield. The bonus equals your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

features.name: Mend Flesh
features.description:
At 6th level, you gain the ability to mend your own flesh. As an action, you can regain hit points equal to three times your wizard level.

You must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

features.name: Malleable Skin
features.description: By 10th level, you can alter your physical form to avoid harm. When you are hit with an attack roll while you are concentrating on a spell with the fleshwarping tag, you can use your reaction to roll a d6. On a 5 or higher, the attack instead misses you, regardless of its roll.

features.name: The Way of All Flesh
features.description:
By 14th level, you have perfected your own flesh. You are immune to any spell or effect that would alter your form or magically age you against your will.

Additionally, you regain 1 hit point at the start of each of your turns (10 hit points each minute) if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points. Also, any of your severed body members (fingers, legs, tails, and so on), if any, are restored after 2 minutes. If you have the severed part and hold it to the stump, you instantaneously cause the limb to knit to the stump.

extra_sections.name: Preamble
extra_sections.text:
Wizard Level Feature

2nd Fleshwarping Savant, Ironhide

6th Mend Flesh

10th Malleable Skin

extra_sections.name: Alter Aspect
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: Self Components: V, S, M (a chameleon scale) Duration: Until dispelled Class: Sorcerer, Wizard

This simple spell is incredibly popular among hags and witches, as well as wizards who study the ancient and twisted art of fleshwarping. You change a part of your physical appearance. You can alter your appearance in one of the following ways:

You change the color and length of your hair. You change the color of your eyes. You adjust your height to be up to 3 inches shorter or taller. You change the shape of your eyebrows, the length of your nose, the size of your ears, or the length of your teeth. You increase the length of your limbs to be up to 3 inches longer or shorter. You change the shape of your mouth and lips.

If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its effects active at a time, and you can dismiss any effect as an action.

extra_sections.name: Amending Flesh
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: Touch Components: V, S, M (a needle) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Class: Cleric, Warlock, Wizard

You imbue the needle to stitch and repair freshly made wounds on the body of a creature you touch. For the duration of the spell, each time the target takes damage, roll 2d4 and reduce the damage it takes by the result.

When the spell ends, a creature who was under this spell's effects can choose whether or not the scars left by the stitching fade away or remain as if freshly healed yet still noticeable.

extra_sections.name: Armament of Flesh
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: Self (5-feet) Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous Class: Sorcerer, Wizard

Uttering the phrase "úr líkama mínum vopn skal komahe", the flesh on your hand and forearm twists into the shape of a grotesque weapon composed of flesh as you strike at a creature within range. The weapon assumes the shape and form of a melee weapon of your choice. As part of the action used to cast this spell, you must make an unarmed strike attack against one creature within the spell's range, otherwise the spell fails. On a hit, the target suffers 1d8 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (your choice).

The spell's damage increases by one die when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

extra_sections.name: Arm Burst
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: 10 feet Components: V, S, M (a spider corpse) Duration: Instantaneous Class: Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard

You cause fully grown fleshy arms to temporarily emerge from your outstretched arm that lash out toward a creature you can see within range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. You have advantage on the attack roll if the target is not wearing armor. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage, and is pushed back 5 feet.

The spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

extra_sections.name: Arms of Stitching
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: Touch Components: V, S, M (a needle and thread) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Class: Warlock, Wizard

You cause the arms of a creature you touch to temporarily and harmlessly sever from its body, connecting to its torso via long threads and stitching. For the duration of the spell, the target's reach increases by 5 feet, and the target can roll a d8 in place of the normal damage of its unarmed strike.

extra_sections.name: Ascended Anatomy
extra_sections.text:
8th-level transmutation (fleshwarping)

Casting Time: 1 action Range: Self Components: V Duration: 1 hour Class: Sorcerer, Wizard

Until the spell ends, when you make a Constitution saving throw, you can replace the number you roll with a 15. Additionally, you are immune to the effects of exhaustion.

extra_sections.name: Coat of Eyes
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: Self Components: V, S Duration: 1 hour Class: Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard

You transform your flesh to grow multiple eyes across your body. The eyes can take on an appearance of your choice, such as appearing similar to your own, appearing like an animal's eyes, or appear milky white and alien. For the duration of the spell, you see in all directions, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. You also have advantage on saving throws against being blinded.

extra_sections.name: Daigon's Second Mouth
extra_sections.text:
6th-level transmutation (fleshwarping)

Casting Time: 10 minutes Range: Self Components: V, S, M (an opal worth 3000 gp, a bowl

of burning incense, three drops of blood, and the tongue, jawbone and teeth of a humanoid or beast, which are consumed) Duration: Instantaneous Class: Wizard

This horrifying spell was created by the ancient Witch Queen Daigon. By way of this ritual, you permanently transform a part of your body, such as the palm of your hand, your stomach, or neck, to grow a fully functioning mouth. This mouth has teeth, lips, and a long tongue. This mouth also possesses its own distinct voice and personality, and when you speak you can choose to speak through this mouth or cause both you and this mouth's voice to speak simultaneously. The mouth can speak every language that you know.

You can consume food and drink via this mouth, and though the mouth does not require air you can choose to breathe out of the mouth (no action required).

While you possess this mouth on your body, you have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks, provided a creature can see this mouth.

You can also use the mouth to make one bite attack against a Small or smaller target that you are grappling. If you are under the Enlarge effect of an enlarge/reduce spell, you can instead use this bite against a Medium or smaller target. If the attack hits, the target takes 2d6 piercing damage and the target is also swallowed into an extra-dimensional space, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside of you, and it takes 4d6 acid damage at the start of each of your turns. You can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

A creature inside the mouth can't leave it by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to leave the mouth, it must first make a Charisma saving throw. On a success, the creature can use that magic to exit the mouth. On a failure, the creature can't exit the mouth and wastes the use of the spell or effect.

If a swallowed creature dies, its body and all nonmagical objects it is wearing and carrying instantly dissolve. Any remaining objects are immediately regurgitated from the mouth into a space within 5 feet of you. The creature's voice is also absorbed by the mouth, and when the mouth speaks, you can choose for the mouth to speak in the voice or utter the sounds of any creature that died while swallowed by it.

You can only possess one of these mouths at a time. When you cast this spell while you already possess a mouth created by this spell, the current mouth closes and a new one appears on a part of your body of your choice.

extra_sections.name: Detect Flesh
extra_sections.text:
1st-level divination (fleshwarping)

Casting Time: 1 action Range: Self Components: V, S Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes Class: Wizard

For the duration, you know if there is any creature with flesh within 30 feet of you, as well as where the creature is located. Similarly, you know if a creature you detect is undead or not. Constructs, incorporeal undead, and creatures that lack flesh and bones are immune to this spell.

The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

extra_sections.name: Diamondskin
extra_sections.text:
7th-level abjuration (fleshwarping)

Casting Time: 1 action Range: 30 feet Components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth 500 gp,

which the spell consumes) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour Class: Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard

This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as diamond. Until the spell ends, the target has immunity to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and has resistance to magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

extra_sections.name: Farrion's Vile Grove
extra_sections.text:
4th-level conjuration (fleshwarping)

Casting Time: 1 action Range: 150 feet Components: V, S, M (a bloodstained rib bone, a

tooth, and a dried finger and tongue) Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes Class: Wizard

This spell was created by the wizard Farrion. Long arms, mounds of flesh with mouths of sharpened teeth, and tendrils of moving flesh emerge from the ground in a 30-foot radius centered on a point within range. The area becomes difficult terrain for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 4d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

For the duration of the spell, the mouths speak in a language of your choice or emit laughter, screams, or whispers.

A creature in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the arms, hands, mouths, and tendrils until the spell ends. A creature restrained by these limbs of flesh can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.

If a creature with flesh dies from damage dealt by this spell, that creature’s body is absorbed and added into the grove.

When the spell ends, the conjured flesh dries out and shrivels in size before fading away into nothing but dust and shriveled ashes.

If you cast Farrion's vile grove every day for 30 days in the same location, the spell lasts until it is dispelled, and the material components are consumed on the last casting.

extra_sections.name: Feast on Self
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: 60 feet Components: V, S, M (a tooth or a claw) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Class: Warlock, Wizard

You cause the flesh of a creature that you can see within range to contort into violent shapes. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the target takes 3d8 slashing damage as parts of its flesh is torn apart, and the spell ends. On a failed save, the target takes 3d8 piercing damage and 3d8 slashing damage as the target's flesh contorts and stretches, growing mouths filled with rows of sharp teeth and hands with vicious claws that shift to tear into the flesh of the target. Until the spell ends, you can use your action on each of your turns to automatically deal 3d8 piercing damage and 3d8 slashing damage to the target. The spell ends if you use your action to do anything else.

At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw. It takes 3d8 piercing damage and 3d8 slashing damage on a failed save, and the spell ends on a successful one.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage of each damage type increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

extra_sections.name: Graft
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: Touch Components: V, S, M (a scalpel or small knife) Duration: Instantaneous Class: Cleric, Wizard

You carve a piece of flesh off from a willing creature you touch and magically transfer it onto the body of another willing creature. Constructs, incorporeal undead, and creatures that lack flesh and bones are immune to this spell. The first target's current hit points are reduced by 2d6, and the second target regains hit points equal to the reduction.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

extra_sections.name: Gyrok's Butchering
extra_sections.text:
2nd-level conjuration (fleshwarping)

Casting Time: 1 action Range: 60 feet Components: V, S, M (a butcher's knife or a meat

cleaver) Duration: Instantaneous Class: Wizard

You temporarily conjure forth butcher knives or meat cleavers to butcher flesh. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within range. On a hit, the target takes 4d12 slashing damage. The conjured knives or cleavers then vanish.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 2nd.

extra_sections.name: Harvest the Gardens of Flesh
extra_sections.text:
9th-level transmutation (fleshwarping)

Casting Time: 1 action Range: 90 feet Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous Class: Warlock, Wizard

You utter a foul incantation that causes the flesh, muscle, and bones of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range to be ripped asunder. Constructs, incorporeal undead, and creatures that lack flesh and bones are immune to this spell.

Each target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 14d6 necrotic damage and is knocked prone as its body is suddenly and violently twisted and contorted into unnatural shapes. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. If a target is killed by this damage, its body is twisted into shredded pieces and you regain hit points equal to the damage it took.

A target that has been knocked prone can can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, the target is no longer knocked prone and its body twists back into its normal shape.

extra_sections.name: Hidden Flesh
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 10 minutes Range: Self Components: V, S, M (a ruby worth at least 1,000 gp,

a vessel worth at least 1,500 gp that has a sealable lid and is large enough to hold a Medium creature, such as a huge urn, coffin, or glass container filled with salt water and at least 1 cubic inch of flesh from a humanoid, which the spell consumes) Duration: Until dispelled Class: Wizard

Uttering the phrase "húð innan húðar", you perform a forbidden ritual wherein you transform the piece of humanoid flesh into a fully mature physical body resembling the race of the humanoid whose flesh you are using. The new body grows from the piece of flesh, producing bones, limbs, fur, scales, and organs appropriate to the race it is growing into. This spell does not create clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on the body.

When the copy is fully developed and grown, it then devours your current self whole. Your current body falls into a catatonic state as it enters an extradimensional space within the new body you created from the spell's flesh material component. While your body inhabits the new body, you are aware of your surroundings as if you were in the new body's space. You can perform all of the actions and movement as normal in your new body as if it were your own body, and you use the racial features of the race whose body you are assuming. Your new body possesses the same amount of hit points as your own body.

If the new body is reduced to 0 hit points or the spell ends, you immediately assume control of your original body and begin to tear and crawl itself out of what remains of the new body, emerging in an adjacent unoccupied space. You emerge from the new body's remnants with your full hit points.

extra_sections.name: Mask of False Flesh
extra_sections.text:
3rd-level transmutation (fleshwarping) (ritual)

Casting Time: 1 action Range: 10 feet Components: V, S, M (the flesh of another creature, a

knife or dagger worth 25 gp, and burning incense) Duration: 24 hours Class: Warlock, Wizard

You touch the flesh of creature or a corpse that still possesses flesh or rotted flesh, tearing a piece off and holding it above the burning incense. You make yourself - though not including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person - perfectly resemble the creature or corpse the flesh was taken from until the spell ends or until you use your action to dismiss it. If the flesh was taken from a corpse, you instead perfectly resemble the visage and appearance that the corpse possessed on its final day of living. This spell does not change your body type, so you must take flesh from a creature or corpse that has the same basic arrangement of limbs and size as you.

The changes wrought by this spell hold up to physical inspection and auditory inspection - for example, anyone who touches you would feel your head and hair, and anyone who hears your voice hears the voice of the creature whose flesh you took or the voice the corpse possessed on its final day of living. Additionally, for the duration of the spell, you have advantage on checks made to pass yourself off as the creature or corpse.

To discern that you are not who you are passing yourself off as, a creature can use its action to inspect your appearance and must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

extra_sections.name: Osseous Armor
extra_sections.text:
3rd-level transmutation (fleshwarping)

Casting Time: 1 bonus action Range: Touch Components: V, S, M (a small skull) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Class: Sorcerer, Wizard

Through the cracking of bones and the tearing of flesh, you force parts of the skeleton of a willing creature you touch to grow out of its skin and form into protective armor across its body. For example, its ribs and sternum might grow out of its torso to form a breastplate, bony spikes might protrude from its arms, back, and hands, and its skull might grow out to surround its head like a helmet. The transformation lasts until the spell ends. For the duration of the spell, the target gains the following benefits:

The target gain a +2 bonus to its AC. The target gains 10 temporary hit points. The target's protruding bones become natural weapons, which it can use to make unarmed strikes. If it hits with them, it deals piercing damage equal to 3d6 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike. When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the attacker takes 1d6 piercing damage.

When the spell ends, the external bones harmlessly recede back into the body.

extra_sections.name: Rend Flesh
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: 30 feet Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous Class: Warlock, Wizard

You attempt to distort and tear into the flesh of a creature of your choice within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature’s flesh and body begin to distort and violently twist as the creature takes 4d6 necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful save. A creature who fails it saving throw also takes a -2 penalty to its AC until the start of your next turn.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

extra_sections.name: Servant of Flesh
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: 30 feet Components: V, S, M (a needle and thread, a scalpel,

1 cubic inch of flesh from a humanoid, which the spell consumes) Duration: Until dispelled Class: Wizard

This spell creates an Small fleshy and functioning body that appears as a twisted version of the humanoid whose flesh was used to cast this spell, the flesh growing to form this body. This small creature is considered a humanoid, and it performs simple tasks at your command until this spell ends or you dismiss the creature, at which point it crumples into a lump of rotting flesh. The servant grows from the flesh into in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. It has AC 13, 10 hit points, each of its ability scores is 8, and it can't attack. It can speak Common and one language of your choice that you know, though its speech choppy and simple. If it drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends and the creature's body and flesh begins to rot. The servant obeys the commands of you and the humanoid whose flesh it grew from.

Once on each of your turns as a bonus action, you can mentally command the servant to move up to 30 feet and interact with an object. The servant can perform simple tasks that a humanoid servant could do, such as fetching things, cleaning, mending, folding clothes, lighting fires, serving food, and pouring wine. Once you give the command, the servant performs the task to the best of its ability until it completes the task, then waits for your next command.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you create one additional fleshy servant for each slot level above 5th. Each of the servants must come from a different 1 cubic inch of flesh from a humanoid.

extra_sections.name: Skinburner
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: 60 feet Components: V, S, M (a poison ivy leaf) Duration: Instantaneous Class: Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard

You cause the flesh of a creature of your choice that you can see within range to burn and flare with red-hot welts. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 1d8 fire damage. If the target is not wearing any armor, it instead takes 1d12 fire damage.

The spell's damage increases by one die when you reach 5th level (2d8 or 2d12), 11th level (3d8 or 3d12), and 17th level (4d8 or 4d12).

extra_sections.name: Svargon's Grotesque Transformation
extra_sections.text:
4th-level transmutation (fleshwarping)

Casting Time: 1 action Range: 60 feet Components: V, S, M (a petrified eye) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Class: Wizard

This spell was a signature creation of the ancient wizard Svargon Kull. You attempt to alter the physical form of a creature you can see within range, transforming them into a manifestation of twisted flesh and bone. Constructs, incorporeal undead, and creatures that lack flesh and bones are immune to this spell. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes transformed into a fleshy abomination and its speed is halved for the duration. At the end of each of the target's turns before the spell ends, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 4d10 necrotic damage as the twisting of its form continues to cause it severe pain. On a successful save, the spell ends.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4th

extra_sections.name: Tendrils of Flesh
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: 30 feet Components: V, S, M (a piece of raw meat) Duration: Instantaneous Class: Sorcerer, Wizard

Wriggling tendrils of sinew and skin tear from your body and launch forward at a creature you can see within range. The creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 1d6 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. until the beginning of its next turn.

The spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

extra_sections.name: Wall of Flesh
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: 120 feet Components: V, S, M (a voodoo doll or a poppet) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Class: Warlock, Wizard

A nonmagical wall of flesh, faces, and limbs conjures into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by- 10-foot sections of flesh and meat. Each section must be contiguous with at least one other panel, stitched together. Alternatively, you can create 10-foot-by-20- foot sections that are only 3 inches thick.

If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (your choice). The inner part of the wall is smoothed skin, while the outer part of the wall consists of moving arms, legs, and faces embedded into the wall, each of which lets out painful moans and cries of anguish. If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its reaction to move up to its speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.

The wall can have any shape you desire, though it can't occupy the same space as a creature or object. The wall doesn't need to be vertical or resting on any firm foundation. It must, however, merge with and be solidly supported by existing ground. Thus you can use this spell to bridge a chasm or create a ramp.

If you create a span greater than 20 feet in length, you must halve the size of each section to create supports. You can crudely shape the wall to create ramparts, battlements, and so on.

The wall is an object made of flesh that can be damaged and thus breached. Each section has AC 14 and 40 hit points per inch of thickness. Reducing a panel to 0 hit points destroys it and might cause connected panels to tear from each other at the GM's discretion.

Whenever a creature begins its turn or moves within 10 feet of the outer part of the wall, that creature must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, arms moving on the side of the wall grab the creature, and the creature is restrained. A creature can use its action to repeat the saving throw, breaking free and ending the effect on a success.

While a creature is restrained, you can use your bonus action to cause the hands or faces in the wall to hit or bite into the creature, dealing 6d8 bludgeoning or piercing damage, respectively. You may also have both the arms and teeth attack the creature while restrained, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning and 3d8 piercing damage.

If a creature with flesh dies from an attack by the wall, that creature’s body is absorbed and added into the wall.

If you maintain your concentration on this spell for its whole duration, the wall becomes permanent and can't be dispelled. Otherwise, the wall disappears when the spell ends.

extra_sections.name: Wings of Flesh
extra_sections.text:
Casting Time: 1 action Range: Self Components: V, S, M (the plucked wing of a bird) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour Class: Sorcerer, Wizard

This spell causes you to sprout forth two pairs of fleshy wings from your back for the duration of the spell. You gain a flying speed equal to twice your walking speed.

If you cast this spell while wearing armor, the spell automatically fails unless the armor is made to accommodate the two pairs of wings, and clothing not made to accommodate your wings might be destroyed when you cast this spell.

As a bonus action, you can have the lower wings transform into long skewers of sharpened bone, or return back to its normal form. While you have these skewers, you can use your action to make two melee spell attacks with them at a target within 15 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 piercing damage.

Alternatively, you can use your action to fire the skewers at a target within 60 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 piercing damage. Regardless of whether you hit or miss, a new set of skewers regrow.

extra_sections.name: Ysaria's Horrid Hand
extra_sections.text:
4th-level necromancy (fleshwarping)

Casting Time: 1 action Range: Self Components: V, S, M (a butcher knife or meat

cleaver) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Class: Warlock, Wizard

This spell was originally created by Ysaria, the last Witch Queen. Wielding the material component in one hand while uttering the phrase "Úr holdi mínu hönd mín skal lifa", you take 2d6 slashing damage as you sever your other hand as it falls onto the ground before you. You immediately regrow a perfect replica of your hand from the stump, leaving a magical scar at your wrist.

The hand then crawls around before you and grows into a Medium sized hand, a large mouth with sharp teeth and long tongue appearing in its palm. It has AC 16, 50 hit points, a climb speed of 40 feet, and a speed of 40 feet. It has immunity to the charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions, and is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form. This severed hand acts on your initiative and has its own action and movement. If the hand drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends, the hand suddenly wilts and fades into dust.

The hand can attempt to bite a creature as an action on its turn. It makes a melee spell attack against the creature, adding your spellcasting ability modifier to the attack roll. On a hit, a target takes 5d6 piercing damage and is restrained by the hand's mouth and long tongue. While it has a creature restrained, the hand cannot attack but it can still move using the fingers of the hand.
